# mxroute_domain (Resource)

Manage a verified mail domain. Create the verification TXT record and allow DNS propagation first. Deleting a domain can affect mail and dependent objects; upstream cascade/recovery behavior is live-unverified. Use `prevent_destroy` for important domains. The provider never purges unmanaged children.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mxroute_domain" "example" {
  # Publish the account verification TXT record before creating this resource.
  domain                    = "example.com"
  mail_hosting              = true
  verification_wait_seconds = 900
  visibility_wait_seconds   = 30

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Canonical DNS name. Changing it replaces the domain.

### Optional

- `mail_hosting` (Boolean) Enable mail hosting. Omission adopts the server value; only an explicit change sends a mail-status update.
- `verification_wait_seconds` (Number) Before creation, poll DNS for the exact account verification TXT record for up to this many seconds (0 disables preflight; maximum 1800). Does not retry rejected API creates.
- `visibility_wait_seconds` (Number) Bound post-create visibility polling in seconds (0 checks once; maximum 1800). Only complete successful lists proving absence are retried.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account-relative domain identity.
- `mail_hosting_pending` (Boolean) True when creation succeeded but requested mail hosting is not confirmed. A warning explains the failed step. Run a normal refreshed plan/apply to finish setup without replacing the domain. During this pending state mail_hosting retains the requested value until refresh.
- `pointers` (Set of String) Read-only pointer name summary. Manage pointers with separate resources.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Server-reported SSL status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_domain.example example.com
```
